headings.usage: Use for all H1, H2, H3, and heavy typographic elements.

body.usage: Use for paragraphs, descriptions, input values, and standard text.

rules: DO NOT use Inter or Roboto.
H1 (Hero): text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter text-black.
Overlines/Labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-bold text-zinc-500.

visual_enhancers.borders: Always use 1px solid border-zinc-200 for structure. No soft shadows everywhere.

grids_and_layouts.bento_grid: For the 7 Benefits: use md:grid-cols-4. 1 hero card (col-span-2 row-span-2), standard cards (col-span-1), wide cards (col-span-2). Gap-6.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8 to p-16 for sections. Dashboard containers must have p-6.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Asymmetric layout. Heavy text on the left, overlapping product UI mockups on the right.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: Sidebar (w-64) + Main Content. Mobile-first responsive with hamburger for sidebar.

components.name: Button
components.instructions: Solid #00AD02 background for primary, text-white. Sharp rounded-md. Hover state: bg-[#008A02] text-white.

components.name: Progress Bar
components.instructions: Use #00AD02 for the indicator. Background zinc-200. Used for the 37/50 usage counter.

components.name: Badge
components.instructions: Flat design. No rounded-full pill shapes, use rounded-md. Colors based on the Status object.

motion.interactions: Hover states must translate-y-[-2px] with subtle shadow change.
motion.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out. DO NOT use generic 'transition: all' in CSS files. Apply Tailwind classes.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for list items in the dashboard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on #00AD02 has minimum 3:1 contrast for large text. Black on white for body.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

image_urls.description: Person working on a laptop, professional modern.
Minimal white office desk, aligns with clean brand.

media.icons: Use lucide-react. Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) optional if needing duotone.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Not recommended for this specific project. Keep the focus strictly 2D, clean, and high-performance to match the 'minimalist, professional, reliable' requirement. Use Framer Motion for 2D UI animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete hybrid fullstack application using React (.js).
Landing Page ('/'): Create the Header, Hero, Problem/Solution, Flow (Cadastrar -> Criar -> Enviar -> Aprovar -> Assinar -> Receber), Benefits (7 cards bento), Pricing, FAQ, Testimonials, Footer.
Dashboard ('/dashboard'): Create Sidebar (Quotes, Clients, Products, Services, Receipts, My Company, My Plan).
Dashboard usage counter: Visually display '37/50' with a green progress bar in the sidebar.
Quotes List: Implement a table or card list with status badges (RASCUNHO, ENVIADO, VISUALIZADO, APROVADO, ASSINADO) using the exact color mappings.
Quote Creation: Build an inline quote editor with a search for products/services and real-time calculation.
Public Quote Page ('/quote/public'): A clean view for clients to APROVAR/ASSINAR/BAIXAR PDF, including a signature canvas placeholder.
Paywall Modal: Implement a modal that blocks quote creation when usage is 50/50, prompting upgrade.
Use only #00AD02, #000000, #FFFFFF, and neutral grays. DO NOT USE blue, purple, orange, pink, or gradients.
Ensure the design feels like a premium Swiss-style fintech: stark white backgrounds, heavy black typography, sharp green actions.
universal_guidelines: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
DO NOT apply universal transitions (e.g. `transition: all`) in CSS.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
NEVER use AI emojis like 🤖🧠 for icons. Use lucide-react.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for components overlaid on top of content (e.g. Headers, Dropdowns).
general_ui_ux_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Buttons should have distinct hover, focus, and active states. Focus states MUST use high contrast rings.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., icons next to text).
Ensure contrast passes APCA/WCAG standards, especially for white text on green backgrounds (use bold/large text or adjust shade if necessary, though #00AD02 is standard).
